increase worldwide as number of priests edges upward the number of catholics worldwide rose by 16.69 million to 1.422 billion last year.
catholics accounted for 17.8 percent of a global population of almost 8 billion.
for the first time in five years, there is an increase in the total number of priests in the world.
the total reached 407,421, up 425 from the previous year.
africa was the only continent to register an increase in religious sisters.
the number of seminarians fell by 2,891 to 103,604. lay missionaries increased by 18,473 to 463,079. the church also runs 75,448 kindergartens, 103,666 primary schools, and 51,810 secondary schools.
healthcare and charitable network include 101,110 facilities, 5,397 hospitals as well as 13,646 dispensaries.
